scripts.build:cpanel: vite build && npm test && node scripts/build-documents.js && powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path mgr-investment-cpanel-deploy.zip) { Remove-Item mgr-investment-cpanel-deploy.zip -Force }; if (Test-Path mgr-investment-cpanel-update-only.zip) { Remove-Item mgr-investment-cpanel-update-only.zip -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path dist\*, dist\.htaccess -DestinationPath mgr-investment-cpanel-deploy.zip -Force; Compress-Archive -Path dist\assets, dist\images, dist\documents, dist\index.html, dist\api.php, dist\sw.js, dist\manifest.webmanifest -DestinationPath mgr-investment-cpanel-update-only.zip -Force"
scripts.build:update: vite build && npm test && node scripts/build-documents.js && powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path mgr-investment-cpanel-update-only.zip) { Remove-Item mgr-investment-cpanel-update-only.zip -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path dist\assets, dist\images, dist\documents, dist\index.html, dist\api.php, dist\sw.js, dist\manifest.webmanifest -DestinationPath mgr-investment-cpanel-update-only.zip -Force"
